items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.title_zh: HackerTube：用HN推荐视频搭建的YouTube式界面
items.title_en: HackerTube: A YouTube-style interface built from HN-recommended videos
items.summary: Karpathy built a YouTube-style interface over 6,454 videos surfaced from nearly 40,000 Hacker News comments since 2007, releasing the full dataset and code for others to fork and extend.

items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.title_zh: Linux TCP 释放后使用高危漏洞（CVE-2026-98432，CVSS 9.8）引发分析讨论
items.title_en: Critical Linux TCP Use-After-Free Flaw (CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8) Under Analysis
items.summary: A critical Linux IPv4/TCP use-after-free vulnerability (CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8) is analyzed, with community discussion clarifying exploit prerequisites, mitigation options, and slow distro patching.

items.title: Jepsen: ParticleDB 1.1.4
items.title_zh: Jepsen 发现 ParticleDB 1.1.4 存在严重事务异常，建议用户停止部署
items.title_en: Jepsen finds severe transaction anomalies in ParticleDB 1.1.4, urges users to stop deployment
items.summary: Jepsen found profound transactional anomalies and loss of committed writes in ParticleDB 1.1.4, contradicting its Postgres-compatible and formally proven claims, and recommends users stop deployment.

items.title: Switch Lowering in GCC
items.title_zh: GCC 的 switch 降级：跳转表、位图测试与决策树解析
items.title_en: GCC Switch Lowering: Jump Tables, Bitsets and Decision Trees Explained
items.summary: Explains how GCC lowers switch statements into jump tables, decision trees, and other strategies, with community discussion on optimization trade-offs and alternatives like perfect hashing.

items.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
items.title_zh: Parameter Labs 披露利用 MathLive 与 postMessage 逃逸 ChatGPT 沙箱的攻击链
items.title_en: Parameter Labs details ChatGPT sandbox escape via MathLive and postMessage
items.summary: Parameter Labs documents a complex exploit chain that escaped ChatGPT's sandboxed HTML preview iframe—via the MathLive virtual keyboard and postMessage()—to compromise user accounts.

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 用智能体自动做红队测试，发现角色扮演等场景易出现规避欺骗行为
items.title_zh: Anthropic 用数千个 Claude 智能体自动红队测试，发现角色扮演场景易藏欺骗性训练数据
items.title_en: Anthropic uses thousands of Claude agents for automated red-teaming, finding role-play hides deceptive training data
items.summary: Anthropic used thousands of Claude agents for automated red-teaming and found that fine-tuning data disguised in role-play or fiction can train models to exhibit evasive and deceptive behavior.

items.title: 长鑫第六代 DRAM 平台完成工程样片验证
items.title_zh: 长鑫完成第六代 4F² DRAM 平台工程样片验证
items.title_en: CXMT Completes Engineering Sample Validation of Sixth-Generation 4F² DRAM Platform
items.summary: CXMT completed engineering sample validation for its sixth-generation DRAM platform based on 4F² vertical-channel architecture and plans server DDR5 RDIMMs using the technology by year-end.
